_doc: בשר ועוף - poultry/beef/lamb/fish cuts, giblets and a few deli-style spreads that share this department. Deli meats (pastrami/salami/kabanos) and smoked/salted salmon+herring live in produce-deli-frozen.json (not duplicated here) - the fresh/frozen 'salmon' base concept lives there too, category בשר ועוף; the salmon-* concepts here only claim the states it deliberately excludes (frozen/whole, portions, cuts). chicken-ground/chicken-sausage/beef-ground were patched this round: the poultry brand suffix 'עוף ירושלים' and 'עוף טוב' contain the substring עופ and were pulling beef products (e.g. 'טחון בקר ... עוף ירושלים') into chicken concepts - see round notes. Spice mixes ('תבלין ל...'), pet food and instant noodles that share meat words with real cuts were left uncaptured on purpose and logged to ops/taxonomy/meat-fish.md as department misroutes, not concepts.
